# Ivan Illich

*1926 – 2002 · Austrian*

A priest turned critic of industrial society, he shows that beyond a certain threshold schooling, medicine or transport produce the opposite of what they promise. Against them he sets "convivial" tools, which anyone can master without depending on experts.
